messages:
sasha: Heads up — scheduled infra apply tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for release/2024.07. We're doing a traffic-shadow for the new edge-gateway module before flipping. Please ack if you need to veto or have a blocker.

oliver: ack, I'll be oncall during the window. No blockers from networking team.

shayla: quick note: provider pin needed for aws provider to avoid drift with the new v2 submodule. Add provider_version = \"~> 4.55.0\" to modules/gateway/provider.tf.

infra-oncall: adding monitoring checklist: create temporary kpi alert for p50/p95 latency and 5min error rate spike > 1.5x baseline. If triggered, escalate and consider rollback.

sasha: plan is: 1) run terraform plan in staging 01:00 to validate 2) apply in prod with traffic-shadow to mirror-only 3) let shadow run for 15m, check metrics 4) if green, schedule small live traffic shift.

deploy-bot: apply job queued by sasha: job id 83921. Plan started: `terraform plan -var-file=release-2024-07.tfvars -lock=true`

oliver: can we run the apply with `-target=module.edge_gateway` only? want to minimize blast radius.

shayla: yes target is fine. Also include `-refresh=false` to avoid noisy state pulls during shadowing.

infra-oncall: rollback playbook summary (copied):
```
1) run: git revert <merge-commit-for-gateway>
2) open PR to revert module version in modules/gateway/versions.tf
3) run: terraform apply -target=module.edge_gateway -var-file=previous_release.tfvars
4) if state mismatch, run state rollback from snapshot `s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/2024-07-10-22`
```
If step 3 fails, notify SRE runbook channel.

sasha: add one more safety: deploy-bot will hold the final traffic cut until a manual `:roll-forward:` emoji from oncall is added to this thread. That gives us pause for last checks.

deploy-bot: shadow started: routing 0% live, 100% mirrored to `edge-gateway-canary` namespace. Job 83921 -> apply step 1 complete. Logs: `applied 3 resources, changed 2`

shayla: seeing small KV-cache warms in canary logs, expected. Watching auth latencies.

infra-oncall: p95 latency +130ms at T+7m, error rate flat. Keep watching. If p95 >200ms for 5m, call rollback.

oliver: confirming backup of current module tag `v1.14.2` stored in releases repo. If we need immediate rollback we can pin back to that tag.

sasha: after 15m if metrics stable we'll request :roll-forward: from oncall and then perform staged shift 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m pauses and checks. Everyone stay on this thread during the window.

infra-oncall: ack, standby for manual go.

deploy-bot: manual hold enforced. To proceed add `:roll-forward:` reaction from infra-oncall or oncall lead.

shayla: left a TODO in the PR to update provider pin and a one-liner release note: "Pinned aws provider 4.55 for gateway apply; shadowed traffic before cutover."

sasha: thanks — will follow through and post final release note after cutover.

oliver: nice and tidy. Good luck. :thumbsup:
